metadata.description: Maps 107 bounded operation-backed direct reads, 12 stream-backed interactive reads with a global one-provider-request budget, and 131 approval-gated one-record direct writes across all 130 mutation endpoints. All 64 source-backed collection streams support saved full-refresh ETL; project-scoped tasks additionally support source-backed event-token incremental modes; all 131 write actions support warehouse-table reverse ETL. Every operation in the pinned OpenAPI ledger has an executable covered_by route, including POST /batch through a closed declaration-backed action selector.

risk.approval: all write execution follows plan -> preview -> explicit approval -> execute; destructive actions also require confirm: destructive
risk.read: 107 operation-backed commands are bounded source reads; the 12 stream-backed interactive commands have one aggregate provider-send and page budget across pagination, retries, redirects, and fan-out; saved full-refresh ETL remains separate and exhaustive; no raw provider query/path passthrough
